title: You Think Eyes See Pixels Like a Camera, Yet One Jammed Slide Revealed Edge Detectors
description:
You think your brain records pixels like a camera! Yet a blinding floodlight leaves vision cells silent! This is the true story of David Hubel's jammed slide. Here is what went wrong in a Baltimore lab.
